hook: AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to start a podcast.
caption:
AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to start a podcast.

I wanted a weekend project. It gave me a product roadmap.

Here's the thing nobody talks about: AI doesn't know if you're a person who needs every detail spelled out — or someone who gets overwhelmed by detail and just needs the first move.

It defaults to comprehensive. Because comprehensive feels helpful.

But for a lot of people, comprehensive is the thing that makes them close the tab and do nothing.

This is the difference between AI that's technically correct and AI that actually knows you.

Some people need the 47 steps. They'd feel anxious without them.

Some people need: "Buy a $60 mic. Record one episode. Don't publish it. Just listen back."

Same question. Completely different answer. Both right — for the right person.

The problem isn't the AI. It's that it has no idea which person you are.

That's exactly what we built BootFile to fix. Your profile tells it how you think, how you make decisions, and how much you need before you'll actually move.

No more plans that paralyze you. No more answers that feel written for someone else.
